recorded_at_basis: Corrected to the first preregistration commit df115313e7c44d2067f632a6dd27f474ac160dc4 commit time. The original manually entered06:30 value was future-dated metadata; Git history proves preregistration before amendment32afd26 at04:04:44 and implementation bda34b3 at04:06:46.
hypothesis: The current bare controller is acceleration-limited on fully settled straights with no detector-recognized obstacle or active latch because its positive gas branches are only 0.18, 0.135 and 0.09. Doubling only those already-eligible propulsion commands should reduce time spent accelerating while the unchanged target-speed and braking controller continues to bound speed before detected bends.

scope.single_factor: Multiply the inherited positive gas command by exactly 2.0 only inside the existing fully settled clear-straight propulsion gate, capped at 0.36.
frozen: straight target 68 and every curve, strong-steering, obstacle and latch target
all perception, steering, retention, obstacle-side and recovery logic
model.pt and every non-bare inference route
official environment, reward, termination, frame skip and action contract

requirements: the inherited action requests positive gas and zero brake
the current frame is classified straight and _pace_straight is true
the frame did not begin with an obstacle miss latch
absolute previous emitted steering is no greater than MAX_STEER_STEP

rejected_alternatives: Do not double target speed: the camera speed estimator clips at 80, so a target above 80 would remove observable closed-loop overspeed regulation.
Do not scale obstacle or miss-latch gas: seeds11/17/21/42 exposed compound-corner and obstacle-transition failures that require exact preservation.
Do not scale clear-curve gas in this experiment: it would spend additional longitudinal tire demand while steering and confound the isolated straight-acceleration hypothesis.
static_acceptance: The three eligible straight branches emit 0.36, 0.27 and 0.18 with finite float32 actions inside official bounds and no gas/brake overlap.
Targets, steering, brakes and all shared inherited state remain exact to control.

Distant-bend entry, every clear curve, strong or unsettled steering, current obstacle, miss frames1--4, latch-clearing frame, reacquisition, opposite transition, reset, invalid observation and lost-road behavior remain action-exact to control.
Randomized differential coverage proves every candidate/control action difference is eligible and gas-only with the registered formula.
Affected controller, inference, local-contract and submission suites pass.
An isolated package passes import, reset, finite-action, bounds and latency smoke without modifying the root submission.zip.
rollback: Any action or shared-state difference outside the eligible gas component.
Any gas increase on an obstacle, detector-miss latch, curve, unsettled-steering, braking, invalid-input or recovery frame.
Any interface, package, dependency, latency, bounds, NaN or reset regression.

future_environment_gate.reason: SOTA.md, RESULTS.md, COMPETITION_INFO.md, RESTRICTIONs.md and report.pdf are absent.
future_environment_gate.design_after_restoration: Freeze paired control and candidate package hashes before using fresh geometry seeds across multiple track_ids. Rank valid finish first, then progress, collisions/crash/off-track and only then paired completed lap time.
future_environment_gate.safety_rollback: Reject on any new paired DNF, lower per-track finish count, additional collision/crash/off-track, materially lower worst progress or operational failure.
future_environment_gate.pace_gate: Only after safety non-regression, require a preregistered meaningful paired lap-time improvement; treat the low-20-second objective separately from physical-speed claims.

evidence_limits: The consumed seed42 FastCorner finisher averaged physical speed38.32 and reached60.20, but its run file is not bound to source/model/package hashes and is hypothesis evidence only.
Doubling a propulsion command does not prove doubled physical velocity or halved lap time because target-speed feedback, drag, corners, braking and traction remain in the loop.

The compact detector ignores bright components outside rows22--61 and outside its area/width/height bounds, so no detected obstacle is not a ground-truth obstacle-free claim; an undetected or merged close obstacle can still receive doubled gas.
A physical bend not yet expressed in sampled camera rows30--54 can be classified straight. Same-input tests cannot prove trajectory-level safety after the higher gas changes future observations.
No environment cell, training run, official submission or SOTA comparison is authorized by this protocol.
